entries.title: Psalms 97:1
segments: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
segments: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

entries.title: Psalms 97:3
segments: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.

entries.title: Psalms 97:4
segments: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.

entries.title: Psalms 97:5
segments: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
segments: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
segments: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
segments: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 97:9
segments: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:10
segments: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
segments: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 97:12
segments: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial [name].
